    # ---- shared plumbing -------------------------------------------------

    def _base(self) -> str:
        base = (self.base_url or "").strip().rstrip("/")
        if not base:
            msg = ("base_url is empty. Point this component's Base URL field at the "
                   "Langflow global variable STEWARD_API_BASE_URL.")
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if not base.startswith("http://") and not base.startswith("https://"):
            msg = "base_url must start with http:// or https://"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return base

    def _headers(self) -> dict:
        token = (self.access_token or "").strip()
        if not token:
            msg = ("access_token is empty. Either tweak this node's Access Token field "
                   "per run, or pass the accessToken value as the tool argument.")
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + token}

    def _call(self, method: str, path: str, body=None, params=None) -> dict:
        try:
            url = self._base() + path
            headers = self._headers()
        except ValueError as ex:
            return {"ok": False, "error": "misconfigured", "message": str(ex)}
        try:
            resp = requests.request(
                method, url, json=body, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=30,
            )
        except Exception as ex:  # noqa: BLE001 - surfaced to the agent as a tool result
            return {"ok": False, "error": "network_error", "message": str(ex)}
        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            try:
                payload = resp.json()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                payload = {}
            err = payload.get("error", {}) if isinstance(payload, dict) else {}
            return {
                "ok": False,
                "status": resp.status_code,
                "error": err.get("code", "http_error"),
                "message": err.get("message", resp.text[:300]),
                "details": err.get("details"),
            }
        if not resp.content:
            return {"ok": True}
        try:
            parsed = resp.json()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return {"ok": True, "raw": resp.text[:300]}
        out = {"ok": True}
        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            out.update(parsed)
        else:
            out["data"] = parsed
        return out

    @staticmethod
    def _txt(value):
        """Trimmed string, or None when the model sent nothing."""
        text = (value or "").strip()
        return text or None

    @staticmethod
    def _flag(value):
        """Models send booleans as strings. None means 'not supplied'."""
        text = (value or "").strip().lower()
        if text in ("true", "yes", "1"):
            return True
        if text in ("false", "no", "0"):
            return False
        return None

    @staticmethod
    def _list(value):
        """Comma-separated -> list. None means 'not supplied'."""
        if value is None:
            return None
        text = str(value).strip()
        if not text:
            return None
        return [part.strip() for part in text.split(",") if part.strip()]

    @staticmethod
    def _slim(task):
        """The subset of a task the agent needs back. Keeps tool results small."""
        if not isinstance(task, dict):
            return None
        keys = ("id", "title", "domain", "kind", "status", "priority", "dueAt", "notes", "tags")
        out = {k: task.get(k) for k in keys if task.get(k) is not None}
        subs = task.get("subtasks")
        if isinstance(subs, list) and subs:
            out["subtasks"] = [
                {"id": s.get("id"), "text": s.get("text"), "done": s.get("done")}
                for s in subs
                if isinstance(s, dict)
            ]
        return out

    @staticmethod
    def _receipt(row, fallback_task_id):
        """One saved question, as the envelope should report it."""
        options = []
        for option in row.get("options") or []:
            if not isinstance(option, dict):
                continue
            slim = {}
            for field in ("label", "dueAt", "title", "notes"):
                value = option.get(field)
                if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
                    slim[field] = value
            if slim.get("label"):
                options.append(slim)
        return {
            "id": row.get("id"),
            "taskId": row.get("taskId") or fallback_task_id,
            "question": row.get("question"),
            "kind": row.get("kind"),
            "costOfWrong": row.get("costOfWrong"),
            "options": options,
        }

    def _emit(self, result) -> Data:
        return Data(value=json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))

    # ---- tool ------------------------------------------------------------

    def holdForClarification(self) -> Data:
        title = self._txt(self.title)
        domain = self._txt(self.domain)
        question = self._txt(self.question)
        if not title or not question:
            return self._emit({"ok": False, "error": "missing_args",
                               "message": "title and question are both required."})
        if domain not in ("health", "home", "car", "finance", "family", "pets"):
            return self._emit({"ok": False, "error": "invalid_domain",
                               "message": "domain must be one of health, home, car, "
                                          "finance, family, pets."})

        kind = self._txt(self.question_kind) or "date"
        if kind not in ("date", "detail", "choice"):
            kind = "date"
        cost = self._txt(self.cost_of_wrong) or "high"
        if cost not in ("low", "high"):
            cost = "high"
        priority = self._txt(self.priority)
        if priority not in ("low", "normal", "high", "urgent"):
            priority = "normal"

        options = []
        raw_options = self._txt(self.options)
        if raw_options:
            try:
                parsed = json.loads(raw_options)
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                parsed = None
            if isinstance(parsed, list):
                for entry in parsed[:4]:
                    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                        continue
                    label = (entry.get("label") or "").strip()
                    if not label:
                        continue
                    option = {"label": label[:80]}
                    for field in ("dueAt", "title", "notes"):
                        value = entry.get(field)
                        if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
                            option[field] = value.strip()
                    options.append(option)

        # ONE call, to a route that does the whole hold.
        #
        # This component used to POST /me/tasks and hand the question back in its
        # result for someone downstream to persist. Nobody did: the backend exposed
        # no way to create a clarification, so the agent said "Filed. What time is
        # it?" and the question was stored NOWHERE. No card, no answer, no matter
        # how faithfully the model echoed the object.
        #
        # POST /me/clarifications creates the task AND the question in one request.
        # The rule that decides whether a guessed date may fire lives there, on the
        # server, rather than in this file where the next prompt edit could lose it.
        payload = {
            "title": title,
            "domain": domain,
            "question": question[:300],
            "kind": kind,
            "costOfWrong": cost,
            "priority": priority,
        }

        # ONE matter, ONE task, but as many QUESTIONS as it has gaps.
        #
        # 2026-08-16: "remind me today to go to the friend" was held once, asking
        # "What time should I remind you - and which friend are you visiting?" with
        # time chips attached. The user tapped "9 am". The row resolved, the task
        # became a 9am reminder, and the which-friend gap ceased to exist. A tapped
        # option can only ever answer ONE question, so two gaps need two rows.
        #
        # `questions` goes on the wire only when there is genuinely more than one,
        # so a single-gap hold sends exactly the body it always sent.
        secondary = self._txt(self.secondary_question)
        if secondary:
            secondary_kind = self._txt(self.secondary_kind) or "detail"
            if secondary_kind not in ("date", "detail", "choice"):
                secondary_kind = "detail"
            payload["questions"] = [
                {"question": question[:300], "kind": kind, "options": options},
                # No options: the secondary gap is a who/what/where the user types.
                # An explicit empty list is SUPPLIED-and-empty, which is what stops
                # the server inheriting the primary's time chips onto it.
                {"question": secondary[:300], "kind": secondary_kind, "options": []},
            ]

        # Best guess, in priority order: explicit guess, else the first option's
        # date. The server applies the same precedence; sending it explicitly keeps
        # the two from disagreeing if one of them changes.
        guess = self._txt(self.due_at_guess)
        if not guess and options:
            guess = options[0].get("dueAt")
        if guess:
            payload["dueAtGuess"] = guess

        if options:
            payload["options"] = options
        tags = self._list(self.tags)
        if tags:
            payload["tags"] = tags[:20]
        notes = self._txt(self.notes)
        if notes:
            payload["notes"] = notes
        source_text = self._txt(self.source_text)
        if source_text:
            payload["sourceText"] = source_text

        held = self._call("POST", "/me/clarifications", body=payload)
        if not held.get("ok"):
            return self._emit(held)

        task = held.get("task") or {}
        clarification = held.get("clarification")

        if held.get("queueFull") or not isinstance(clarification, dict):
            # The user already has as many open questions as they will ever get
            # through, so the item was filed with the best guess and NO question.
            # Say that, rather than letting the agent claim it asked something.
            return self._emit({
                "ok": True,
                "task": self._slim(task),
                "clarification": None,
                "queueFull": True,
                "note": "Too many open questions. The matter was filed with the best "
                        "guess and no question was asked - tell the user what you "
                        "assumed instead of asking.",
            })

        # Receipts, not a data channel: the rows are already saved and this is only
        # what the envelope reports back. A model that mangles them can no longer
        # lose a question.
        #
        # `clarifications` is every row the hold created, in order; `clarification`
        # stays the first one so a reader written against the single-question shape
        # is unaffected. An older backend answers without the array - fall back to
        # the single row rather than reporting nothing.
        rows = held.get("clarifications")
        if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
            rows = [clarification]
        receipts = [
            self._receipt(row, task.get("id")) for row in rows if isinstance(row, dict)
        ]
        return self._emit({
            "ok": True,
            "task": self._slim(task),
            "clarification": receipts[0],
            "clarifications": receipts,
            "clarificationId": receipts[0].get("id"),
        })

from typing import Any

from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from lfx.base.models.model import LCModelComponent
from lfx.base.models.openai_constants import OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL_NAMES, OPENAI_REASONING_MODEL_NAMES
from lfx.field_typing import LanguageModel
from lfx.field_typing.range_spec import RangeSpec
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput, DictInput, DropdownInput, IntInput, SecretStrInput, SliderInput, StrInput
from lfx.log.logger import logger
from lfx.utils.secrets import secret_value_to_str


class OpenAIModelComponent(LCModelComponent):
    display_name = "OpenAI"
    description = "Generates text using OpenAI LLMs."
    icon = "OpenAI"
    name = "OpenAIModel"

    inputs = [
        *LCModelComponent.get_base_inputs(),
        IntInput(
            name="max_tokens",
            display_name="Max Tokens",
            advanced=True,
            info="The maximum number of tokens to generate. Set to 0 for unlimited tokens.",
            range_spec=RangeSpec(min=0, max=128000),
        ),
        DictInput(
            name="model_kwargs",
            display_name="Model Kwargs",
            advanced=True,
            info="Additional keyword arguments to pass to the model.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="json_mode",
            display_name="JSON Mode",
            advanced=True,
            info="If True, it will output JSON regardless of passing a schema.",
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="model_name",
            display_name="Model Name",
            advanced=False,
            options=OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL_NAMES + OPENAI_REASONING_MODEL_NAMES,
            value=OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL_NAMES[0],
            combobox=True,
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="openai_api_base",
            display_name="OpenAI API Base",
            advanced=True,
            info="The base URL of the OpenAI API. "
            "Defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1. "
            "You can change this to use other APIs like JinaChat, LocalAI and Prem.",
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="api_key",
            display_name="OpenAI API Key",
            info="The OpenAI API Key to use for the OpenAI model.",
            advanced=False,
            value="OPENAI_API_KEY",
            required=True,
        ),
        SliderInput(
            name="temperature",
            display_name="Temperature",
            value=0.1,
            range_spec=RangeSpec(min=0, max=1, step=0.01),
            show=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="seed",
            display_name="Seed",
            info="The seed controls the reproducibility of the job.",
            advanced=True,
            value=1,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_retries",
            display_name="Max Retries",
            info="The maximum number of retries to make when generating.",
            advanced=True,
            value=5,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="timeout",
            display_name="Timeout",
            info="The timeout for requests to OpenAI completion API.",
            advanced=True,
            value=700,
        ),
    ]

    def build_model(self) -> LanguageModel:  # type: ignore[type-var]
        logger.debug(f"Executing request with model: {self.model_name}")
        logger.debug(f"API key type: {type(self.api_key)}, value: {'***' if self.api_key else None}")
        api_key_value = secret_value_to_str(self.api_key) if self.api_key else None
        logger.debug(f"Final api_key_value type: {type(api_key_value)}, value: {'***' if api_key_value else None}")

        # Handle model_kwargs and ensure api_key doesn't conflict
        model_kwargs = self.model_kwargs or {}
        # Remove api_key from model_kwargs if it exists to prevent conflicts
        if "api_key" in model_kwargs:
            logger.warning("api_key found in model_kwargs, removing to prevent conflicts")
            model_kwargs = dict(model_kwargs)  # Make a copy
            del model_kwargs["api_key"]

        parameters = {
            "api_key": api_key_value,
            "model_name": self.model_name,
            "max_tokens": self.max_tokens or None,
            "model_kwargs": model_kwargs,
            "base_url": self.openai_api_base or "https://api.openai.com/v1",
            "max_retries": self.max_retries,
            "timeout": self.timeout,
        }

        # TODO: Revisit if/once parameters are supported for reasoning models
        unsupported_params_for_reasoning_models = ["temperature", "seed"]

        if self.model_name not in OPENAI_REASONING_MODEL_NAMES:
            parameters["temperature"] = self.temperature if self.temperature is not None else 0.1
            parameters["seed"] = self.seed
        else:
            params_str = ", ".join(unsupported_params_for_reasoning_models)
            logger.debug(f"{self.model_name} is a reasoning model, {params_str} are not configurable. Ignoring.")

        parameters["stream_usage"] = True
        output = ChatOpenAI(**parameters)
        if self.json_mode:
            output = output.bind(response_format={"type": "json_object"})

        return output

    def _get_exception_message(self, e: Exception):
        """Get a message from an OpenAI exception.

        Args:
            e (Exception): The exception to get the message from.

        Returns:
            str: The message from the exception.
        """
        try:
            from openai import BadRequestError, NotFoundError
        except ImportError:
            return None
        if isinstance(e, NotFoundError):
            body = getattr(e, "body", None) or {}
            if isinstance(body, dict) and body.get("code") == "model_not_found":
                return (
                    f"Model '{self.model_name}' is not available for this OpenAI account. "
                    "Your API tier may not have access yet — check "
                    "https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/limits "
                    "or select a different model."
                )
        if isinstance(e, BadRequestError):
            message = e.body.get("message")
            if message:
                return message
        return None

    def update_build_config(self, build_config: dict, field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None) -> dict:
        if field_name in {"base_url", "model_name", "api_key"} and field_value in OPENAI_REASONING_MODEL_NAMES:
            build_config["temperature"]["show"] = False
            build_config["seed"]["show"] = False
            # Hide system_message for o1 models - currently unsupported
            if field_value.startswith("o1") and "system_message" in build_config:
                build_config["system_message"]["show"] = False
        if field_name in {"base_url", "model_name", "api_key"} and field_value in OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL_NAMES:
            build_config["temperature"]["show"] = True
            build_config["seed"]["show"] = True
            if "system_message" in build_config:
                build_config["system_message"]["show"] = True
        return build_config
